limitations: Contrast thresholds are internal readability heuristics, not a complete accessibility certification.
No universal cut-count, movement ratio or maximum hold duration certifies quality.
Model judgments and scene declarations do not constitute human review.

findings.uncertainty: Effective geometry and opacity; perceived dominance still requires pixel review.
findings.correction: Reduce, stagger or visually subordinate competing support and accent elements.

limitations: Checkpoints do not prove continuous motion, material relevance or action completion.
Declared contrast findings require review against the decoded images.
Human scores are never inferred from successful decoding.
Whole-video coverage is false until every required interval is inspected at its declared density.
